about: Parkland County is a municipal district west of Edmonton, wrapping around the separate cities of Spruce Grove and Stony Plain rather than forming a city of its own. Hamlets such as Entwistle, Wabamun, Duffield, and Tomahawk sit among lakes, acreages, and farms on the Yellowhead corridor. Wabamun Lake and Chickakoo Lake are the main recreation landscapes. About 32,000 people live in Parkland County.
seoSummary: Municipal district west of Edmonton, a countryside of lakes and hamlets around Spruce Grove—not a city.
